pillars: No accounts, revenue figure, emissions data or sustainability report are published; the Big Four auditor the company says it hired is not named.
Small, low-cost uncrewed systems use far less material than crewed warships, but the group reports no energy use or emissions for its 15 sites.
Staff tripled to more than 1,000 and the products defend a country under attack, but lethal autonomous systems raise open questions on human oversight.

A strong board (Honcharuk, Wallace, Cavoli), but two Ukrainian nationals each hold 25-50% and the UK register lists the persons with significant control as not available; Cavoli is also a partner of the lead investor.

esg.summary: UFORCE has no record of fines and its products defend Ukraine, but it publishes no financial or environmental data and its owners are not named in the UK register.
